items.text: Mutumin da ya zo jiya malaminmu ne.

translation_en.text: The man who came yesterday is our teacher.

items.label: beta

items.text: Da na sani, da ban zo ba.

translation_en.text: Had I known, I would not have come.

items.label: beta

items.text: Don Allah ka taimake ni.

translation_en.text: Please help me.

items.label: beta

items.text: Duk da haka, gwamnati ta ce za ta ci gaba da shirin.

translation_en.text: Even so, the government said it will continue with the plan.

items.label: beta

items.text: Manoma kan yi noma da safe.

translation_en.text: Farmers usually farm in the morning.

items.label: beta

items.text: A ganina, ilimi kyauta ya taimaka wa yara da yawa.

translation_en.text: In my view, free education has helped many children.

items.label: beta

items.text: Ba na tsammanin wannan shiri zai yi nasara ba tare da goyon bayan jama'a ba.

translation_en.text: I don't think this plan will succeed without public support.

items.label: beta
items.text_original: Ban tsammani wannan shiri zai yi nasara ba tare da goyon bayan jama'a ba.

items.text: Na yarda da kai kaɗan, amma ba gaba ɗaya ba.

translation_en.text: I agree with you a little, but not entirely.

items.label: beta

items.text: Da alama farashin abinci zai ci gaba da hauhawa bana.

translation_en.text: It seems food prices will keep rising this year.

items.label: beta

items.text: Yana da muhimmanci a saurari ɓangarorin biyu kafin a yanke shawara.

translation_en.text: It is important to hear both sides before deciding.

items.label: beta

items.text: Ina ganin ya kamata a ba matasa ƙarin dama a shugabanci.

translation_en.text: I think young people should be given more opportunity in leadership.

items.label: beta

items.text: Ɗalibin da ya ci kyauta ƙanina ne.

translation_en.text: The student who won the prize is my younger brother.

items.label: beta

items.text: Gidan da muka gina bara an sayar da shi.

translation_en.text: The house we built last year has been sold.

items.label: beta

items.text: Mutanen da suke zaune a birni suna biyan kuɗin haya mai yawa.

translation_en.text: People who live in the city pay a lot of rent.

items.label: beta

items.text: Littafin da ka ara min yana da daɗin karatu.

translation_en.text: The book you lent me is pleasant to read.

items.label: beta

items.text: Wurin da muka haɗu karo na farko ya canza.

translation_en.text: The place where we first met has changed.

items.label: beta

items.text: Malamin da yake koya mana lissafi yana da tsauri.

translation_en.text: The teacher who teaches us maths is strict.

items.label: beta

items.text: Idan ka zo da wuri, za mu tafi tare.

translation_en.text: If you come early, we will go together.

items.label: beta

items.text: Da ina da kuɗi, da na sayi gona.

translation_en.text: If I had money, I would have bought a farm.

items.label: beta

items.text: Idan aka yi ruwan sama yau, za a ɗage taron.

translation_en.text: If it rains today, the meeting will be postponed.

items.label: beta

items.text: Idan ba ka ci abinci da kyau ba, za ka raunana.

translation_en.text: If you don't eat well, you will become weak.

items.label: beta

items.text: Da na isa, sun riga sun tafi.

translation_en.text: When I arrived, they had already left.

items.label: beta

items.text: Yana karatu lokacin da wuta ta ɗauke.

translation_en.text: He was reading when the power went off.

items.label: beta

items.text: Har yanzu bai iso gida ba.

translation_en.text: He hasn't reached home yet.

items.label: beta

items.text: Ban taɓa zuwa Kano ba.

translation_en.text: I have never been to Kano.

items.text: Dattawa kan zauna ƙarƙashin wannan bishiya da yamma.

translation_en.text: Elders usually sit under this tree in the evening.

items.text: Da farko, bari mu duba matsalar kanta.

translation_en.text: First, let us look at the problem itself.

items.text: Bugu da ƙari, kuɗin mota ya ƙaru.

translation_en.text: Moreover, transport fares have increased.

items.label: beta

items.text: Saboda haka, muna buƙatar sabon tsari.

translation_en.text: Therefore, we need a new plan.

items.label: beta

items.text: Misali, makarantu da yawa ba su da ɗakin karatu.

translation_en.text: For example, many schools have no library.

items.label: beta

items.text: A gefe guda kuma, iyaye ma suna da nauyi.

items.label: beta

items.text: A ƙarshe, taron ya ƙare lafiya.

translation_en.text: Finally, the meeting ended peacefully.

items.label: beta

items.text: Don Allah ka yi haƙuri da jinkirin da na yi.

translation_en.text: Please excuse my lateness.

items.label: beta

items.text: Ko za ka taimaka min in ɗauki wannan kaya?

translation_en.text: Could you help me carry this load?

items.label: beta

items.text: Barka da zuwa, ka ji kamar a gida kake.

translation_en.text: Welcome, feel at home.

items.label: beta

items.text: Allah ya jiƙan sa, Allah ya ba ku haƙuri.

translation_en.text: May God have mercy on him and grant you patience.

items.label: beta

items.text: Na gode da karamcinku.

translation_en.text: Thank you for your generosity.

items.label: beta

items.text: Ranka ya daɗe, ina neman izinin tafiya.

translation_en.text: Long live you (sir), I seek permission to leave.

items.label: beta

items.text: Ina neman aikin da aka tallata a jarida.

translation_en.text: I am seeking the job advertised in the newspaper.

items.label: beta

items.text: Ina da ƙwarewar shekara biyar a fannin lissafin kuɗi.

translation_en.text: I have five years' experience in accounting.

items.label: beta

items.text: Albashina bai isa in biya duk buƙatuna ba.

translation_en.text: My salary is not enough to meet all my needs.

items.text: Ina fama da zazzaɓi tun jiya da dare.

translation_en.text: I have had a fever since last night.

translation_en.text: Mosquitoes spread malaria.

items.text: Wata rana, wani maharbi ya tafi daji shi kaɗai.

translation_en.text: One day, a hunter went to the bush alone.

items.label: beta

items.text: Kwatsam, sai ya ji wata murya mai ban mamaki.

translation_en.text: Suddenly, he heard a strange voice.

items.label: beta

items.text: Ya yi ƙoƙarin komawa gida amma ya ɓata.

translation_en.text: He tried to go home but got lost.

items.text: A ƙarshe, mutanen ƙauye suka same shi.

translation_en.text: In the end, the villagers found him.

translation_en.text: Elders are greeted respectfully, often by kneeling or crouching.

items.text: Ba a karɓar abu daga babba da hannun hagu.

translation_en.text: One does not receive something from an elder with the left hand.

items.label: beta

items.text: Ana raɗin suna a rana ta bakwai bayan haihuwa.

translation_en.text: The naming ceremony is held on the seventh day after birth.

translation_en.text: Modesty and respect are important in Hausa culture.
